clips.end_words: I manifested that with my mind
clips.caption:
Before he had any money, Kevin Trudeau decided exactly what he wanted - a 1967 or '68 Camaro convertible, brand new condition.

That Sunday he found a classified ad: a 1967 Firebird convertible, 1,500 original miles, for $1,500. Had to be a scam at that price.

He drove out anyway. An old woman led him to a dusty garage. Under the cover: a brand new 1967 Firebird, exactly as advertised.

Her son had bought it right before being drafted to Vietnam. He never came home. She'd kept it on blocks ever since, waiting.

Have you asked for something specific enough that it could actually be delivered?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #yourwishisyourcommand #mindsetmatters #manifesting

Kevin Trudeau once handed a friend in Henderson, Nevada his Your Wish Is Your Command program. The guy listened to the whole thing in one night.

Eighteen months later: $4 million net. The part Kevin says matters most - 90 days of work, under 10 hours a week, then he stopped. The money kept coming every month after, no extra work needed.

That same friend built something even bigger: a glass bridge out over the Grand Canyon. Engineers and the government said it couldn't be done.

He built it anyway. You can walk out and look straight down.

What's the 'impossible' idea you've been told to drop?
